name: terminal
description: Terminal skills for a coding agent: shared-pane (one WezTerm window the user and the agent both drive, for passwords, MFA and interactive logins), new-warp-chat (open a seeded tab in the running Warp terminal), breakout (open a fresh chat of the same CLI in a new Warp tab), and agent-menu (standing Warp tabs that open a home / project / resume menu per agent CLI).

interface.shortDescription: Share a WezTerm window for logins, and open seeded chats in new Warp tabs.
interface.longDescription: Skills for working across terminal windows: shared-pane opens one WezTerm window where the user types a password or approves MFA and the agent keeps driving the same authenticated shell; new-warp-chat opens a new tab in the running Warp terminal that runs a command with an optional seed prompt; breakout uses it to open a fresh chat of the same CLI, launched with the flags from the user's own config; agent-menu sets up one standing Warp tab per agent CLI that opens a menu for a fresh session at home, a session in a project, or the resume list, with launch flags kept in one per-user file.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open a fresh chat in a new tab.
